description.en: SC3 is a multi-solvent solubility benchmark built on BigSolDB v2.1 with 101,535 measurements over 1,327 solutes and 206 solvents. It features a reproducible curation pipeline, nested Gold/Silver/Bronze consensus tiers, leakage-checked splits, and a multi-solvent metric suite (PS-RMSE, Z-RMSE).
